title: Gar ho meri hayaat mere ikhteyar me
body:
Gar ho meri hayaat mere ikhteyar me
Al-ajal al-ajal ya imam e zamana al-ajal..(2)
<<MINI>>
gar ho meri hayaat mere ikhteyar me, sadiya guzar dunga tere intezar me
<<DIVIDER>>
maula ab aap pardae ghaibat uthaiye, do din to zindagi ke guzaru bahar me
1. Is waqt garche adl se khali zameen hai
mazloom ke makaan me zalim makeen hai
duniya sitam sha’ar hai maghloob deen hai
<<DIVIDER>>
maula zaroor aaenge mujhko yaqeen hai
mujhko yaqeen hai..(2)
aaegi kuch kami na mere aitbaar me

2. Sab log khwahishat ke ab hogaye ghulam
Iblisiyat ka daur hai be pardagi hai aam
peene lage lahu hai to khane lage haram
kehta hai dil ke bus abhi aajaiye imaam
aajaiye imaam..(2)
gar der hai mashiyat e parwardigaar me

ghaibat ke imtehaa me sahara hai ya husain
qurane ehle bait ka paara hai ya husain
haqne hamare dil pe utara hai ya husain
utara hai ya husain..(2)

maula is imtehan me dil ko sukoon de
roza namaze haq ke manasik ada kare
hum sham karbala ki ziyarat ko jaa sake
ziyrarat ko jaa sake..(2)
aajaega qaraar dile beqaraar me

kuch saamne hai aur pase manzar kuch aur hai
abhi yazidiyat ke mazalim ka taur hai
garche ye momineen pe mushkil ka daur hai
mushkil ka daur hai..(2)

6. Ehle aza ko jur'at o tadbeer chahiye
dekha hai khwab khwab ki tabeer chahiye
taskeen qalbe madar e shabbir chahiye
ab jannat ul baqi ki tameer chahiye
tameer chahiye..(2)
ajaegi bahar is ujde dayaar me

7. Alfaaz se dilo pe hukumat mili mujhe

kitne ameer hogaye is dar ki bheek se
sab apne apne hisse ki khairat le gaye
zikre imame asr me hissa qamar mile
hissa qamar mile..(2)
